title: 🛡 81Guards Security — Smart Surveillance & Guard Management System
features:
1. Real-time guard tracking and checkpoint verification via QR/NFC
  2. Incident logging with image and video evidence upload
  3. Automated attendance and shift scheduling
  4. Encrypted authentication and secure data handling
  5. Cloud-based file storage with AWS S3 integration
  6. Responsive admin dashboard with analytics and reports
description:
81Guards Security is a robust web and mobile-based guard management and surveillance platform that enables organizations to monitor, track, and manage security personnel across multiple locations in real time.

The system integrates checkpoint scanning, incident logging, attendance tracking, and scheduling with secure authentication and cloud storage (AWS S3) built for high performance, reliability, and user experience.
